comment: not carried: Kotlin conditions on aspects
not carried: mulch, growth factors and mutations, the growth time (random ticks stand in for it), and the machine's charge
not carried: npc_presets parties, NPC battle AI and rewards
not carried: critical captures and the ancient balls' hops in place of shakes
not carried: other abilities, trapping abilities (Arena Trap, Shadow Tag, Magnet Pull), Grassy Glide's priority, Nature Power and Secret Power, and double battles
not carried: alphas (and their herds, bucket boss), herd weight multipliers, and entries for other properties (a Squawkabilly colour, region_bias), which spawn as the species

not carried: the ruins' suspicious sand and gravel finds (Bedrock gives nothing for a suspicious block placed from a structure, and the script's fossil finds only know the fossil formations), and a structure never grows past its start piece
not carried: a center inside the village's own street layout, and the Nurse's levels
not carried: the villages' berry farms and long path
not carried: leaf decay, fruit falling when its leaf goes, and the boats, which are items with no boat to ride
not carried: Double, Triple, Multi and Royal Battles (the format arrows stay on Single)

not carried: signs and hanging signs (Bedrock custom blocks cannot hold editable text), door hinges on the right, and apricorn and saccharine leaves drop themselves to shears or Silk Touch, sticks one time in fifty otherwise, and draw one side of each face so neighbours do not z-fight

not carried: the 75 evolutions that need a biome (the regional forms), a structure, a number of move uses or defeats, or an advancement (blocks travelled and Gimmighoul's coins are in the species bars row) An evolution brings Evolution.evolve's side effects: the result's form (Grotle holding a sapling becomes that tree's Torterra, Rockruff at night Midnight Lycanroc; of two evolutions into one species the one asking more comes first), the moves it learns into a free slot (Torterra's Earthquake), a held item kept where consumeHeldItem is false, its drops (a Turtle Scute, a Shed Shell), and Nincada's Shedinja into the party if there is room and a Poke Ball to use
not carried: alpha chance (the port has no alphas), the fishing line, the bobber's animations, and the fishing spawns that need a structure, nearby blocks or a slime chunk

not carried: the multiblock's exact layout rules, the machine's sounds and animated screens (each shows its first frame), shiny and alpha rolls on the revived Pokemon, and natural materials that are Cobblemon items not ported here

not carried: Pokemon this port has no model for (Groudon, Kyogre, Dialga, Zacian and others in the Elite Four's and Terry's teams, and Magearna in Clair's) are left out of those teams, and nine moves the battle does not know are dropped; Lorelei's double battle is fought as a single battle; the trainer AI does not switch out on its own; RCT's random loot is not given; and the League's villager is not placed
not carried: other vanilla items (held but not drawn), and the 3D look of block items

not carried: the held items that need terrain (the terrain seeds), items with 3D or animated models (the ones not made here), and Poke Puffs, which Cobblemon itself has switched off (its item registration is commented out)
not carried: the paddles' rowing (they rest at the sides), and a pot already holding a vanilla flower is not told apart from an empty one, since a script cannot see a vanilla pot's plant
not carried: the screen lighting up and the lectern giving light while someone reads it (the Pokedex form gives no close event to turn it off), and its constant redstone signal
not carried: the display case shows no item, signs (see building blocks), the Relic Coin Sack's and Pouch's coin behaviour, and the type gem clusters' and budding tumblestone's growth
not carried: particles following a bone (a script places them at the feet, body or head), move_to_target walks, and particle sounds

not carried: the spawns that need any other structure (Cobblemon's ruins and shipwreck coves, the vanilla structures), since the script API tells what structure a block is in only with the Beta APIs experiment, and lava's surface spawns

not carried: Fortune (Bedrock loot cannot tell the enchantment, so its bonus count is dropped rather than made the whole count), Hearty Grains in the wild (they stand in water, which a Bedrock custom block cannot hold), the saccharine tree's bee nests and honey, and Cobblemon's advancements, which Bedrock add-ons cannot add
not carried: the keybinds themselves (Bedrock lets a pack add no keys), throwing the ball by hand, and sending out onto water platforms
not carried: the Pokemon models in the portrait windows, the level-up scroll
not carried: the per-chunk crowding limit
not carried: dragging, the alpha wallpaper (the port has no alphas)
not carried: the crumbs on a Pokemon that ate (the poke_snack_crumbed aspect), candles, the snack's colour, and its bait after it is broken (it drops a plain Poke Snack)

not carried: the sounds, which are Java sound ids, Furfrou's trim script, and the Rotom form files An interaction for one form is kept to that form's variants (a Frost Rotom fills a bucket with powder snow, no other Rotom)
not carried: the female-only milking (Bouffalant, Gogoat, Skiddo), as a Bedrock interaction cannot test gender
not carried: posed animation (portraits are still) and Cobblemon's PROFILE sprite overrides
not carried: the fliers' and swimmers' turning and pitch models (Bedrock steers them), and ride sounds
not carried: the rotating model, and Hisui's regional bias (its starters are the ordinary forms)
not carried: the partner mark and the ribbons' sources (Cobblemon's own code grants neither, nor the Mini and Jumbo marks, which it defines but never awards)

not carried: the Pokemon model in the portrait (a still portrait stands in), and the Other page's arrows to a second page (no species has more than four bars) Cobblemon opens it with a key (M); here the Party item does, used while sneaking and looking straight up, for the selected Pokemon in its ball or out
not carried: the machine's own item slots and hoppers, and the spinning disc animation
not carried: the 33 TMs whose moves the battles do not have
not carried: spectating from the player wheel, and the trade's 3D models (the portraits are the rendered icons)
